about: Compressed bytes for /en under reduced motion, before any scrolling. Measured 30 Sep 2026: main 195,465 script / 98,040 font / 10,101 CSS / 1,085,266 image; that release 208,623 / 106,048 / 16,832 / 1,085,266. Desk story (2 Oct 2026): 218,310 / 47,964 / 18,802 / 1,076,728; the script ceiling takes the plan's 10 KB allowance for the story timeline, measurement and XP desktop controls (three.js stays in the lazily loaded scene), and the font ceiling follows the opening no longer loading Newsreader. With the AVIF opening portrait (2 Oct 2026): 218,328 / 47,964 / 17,619 / 151,986; the image ceiling drops from 1,150,000 to 250,000. Final polish (4 Oct 2026): 175,628 / 47,964 / 19,655 / 151,986 after removing motion (the journey reads scroll directly; the project stack is a CSS scroll-driven animation); the script ceiling drops to the measurement plus 8 KB. Studio About (4 Oct 2026): 176,459 / 47,964 / 20,041 / 151,986; the stylesheet ceiling rises to 21,000 for the About paper grain, poster and pause rules (the lab review styles ride in the shared chunk, see PR 03). Review fixes (5 Oct 2026): 178,099 / 47,964 / 21,001 / 151,986; the stylesheet ceiling rises to 21,500 for the nav pinning itself under keyboard focus on touch screens (focusing the skip link no longer scrolls the page to the top). Error boundaries (5 Oct 2026): 181,691 / 47,964 / 21,079 / 151,986; the page and root error boundaries ship with every first load, so they use plain anchors rather than next/link (global-error would carry its own copy). Bliss on first move (8 Oct 2026): 183,764 / 47,964 / 21,509 / 151,986; the stylesheet ceiling rises to 21,600 for the rule that keeps the MacBook's Bliss layers (about 270 KB of images) from loading with the page. Quality tiers (8 Oct 2026): 184,152 script; the script ceiling rises to 184,500 because the journey decides at hydration whether a computer without GPU acceleration reads the plain flow (src/lib/quality.ts), which keeps the model and 3D code from loading there. Butter series (9 Oct 2026): 184,620 script after B1 (the shared QA switch and the WebGL probe) and B2 (the scroll-pause helper the section stages import); the script ceiling rises to 185,000. Quieter scroll path (9 Oct 2026): 185,010 / 47,964 / 21,691 / 151,986; the script ceiling rises to 185,300 for the single scroll dispatcher, the zero-distance scroll guard and the wait for a scroll pause before the desk turns on (the bar's morph loads at idle, outside the first load), and the stylesheet ceiling to 21,800 for the opening's scroll-timeline fade, the pulse ring and the bar's surface layer.
